Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Hema - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vimla - 66 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The classroom - a blackboard, benches
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Ishaan: "What lovely weather!"

[Ishaan shakes his head.]

Ishaan: "Yes, of course."

[Ishaan scratches his head.]

Ishaan: "Yes, of course."

[Ishaan bursts out laughing.]

Ishaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Hema: "And then?"

Scene 2: The classroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the classroom. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan writes on the blackboard.]

Ishaan: "That's easy."

[Ishaan reads his book at his desk.]

Hema (happily): "Hey, look at that!"

[Ishaan yawns in the class.]

Hema: "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Hema and Vimla stand near him.]

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan sips hot tea from a cup.]

Vimla: "That was fun!"

[Ishaan writes in his notebook.]

Ishaan: "That was such a fun day!"
